page.layout: One page of index, two columns under a centred heading "INDEX."; the left column is read first, then the right. The lower part of both columns is covered by a grey card. No margin notes, page number or running head.
page.notes: The grey card covers the lower part of both columns, so later entries are not visible and are not transcribed. In the left column, "intelliguntur" is hard to read: the letters after "intellig" are uncertain. The "242" stands alone under the left column and may belong to a cut-off line. The right-hand column's top entry "stimonium" begins mid-word on the scan, so it is a fragment. The red stamp and show-through text at the bottom edge are not printed text and are left out.
